description: Section 9 / graph-validation: a `conditional` edge with an empty condition is REFUSED before any node runs. A conditional edge exists to gate, and an edge type whose entire purpose is to gate cannot default to a silent no — the run would succeed with the branch simply absent and nothing in the record saying the author forgot to write the expression.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-29. This vector previously asserted that the edge simply did not fire, and named itself `blank_condition_does_not_fire`. That was reified from the DAG-WALK layer, where an empty expression does evaluate to false — without noticing that the oracle's parser refuses the graph one layer earlier, so no walk ever happens. Nashira accepted such a graph and was tightened to match. The lesson generalises: read a value at the layer the CONTRACT can speak about, not merely at the layer that produced it.
